title: Raceresult Metric0 Weekend vs Weekday Split
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=raceresult:metric0
| eval dow=strftime(_time,"%u")
| eval bucket=if(dow>=6,"weekend","weekday")
| stats count as events, avg(value) as avg_value by bucket
description: Compares weekend versus weekday event counts and average value for raceresult metric0.
value: Weekend/weekday splits expose lifestyle rhythm changes and work-life boundary shifts.
implementation: Tag raceresult metric0 events as weekend or weekday and compare volume and `value`.
visualization: Side-by-side bar chart for weekend vs weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It combines whether your raceresult metric0 activity looks different on weekends compared with weekdays.
